resources.string: Without a screen lock, anyone who picks up the phone gets all your chats. Set a PIN, pattern or fingerprint in system settings.
A screen lock is set: someone who picks up the phone cannot open your chats without it.
This device appears to be rooted. Root lets any app read other apps\' data, including your messages. If you didn\'t root it yourself, have the phone checked.
No signs of root were found. Root would let any app read other apps\' data, including your messages.
USB debugging lets a computer control this phone over a cable. Handy for developers, risky for everyone else — turn it off unless you are using it right now.
USB debugging is off, so a computer cannot control this phone over a cable.
The last security update on this phone is over a year old, so known vulnerabilities stay open. Check for a system update; if none comes, treat this device as less trusted.
This phone\'s last security update is less than a year old.
A cloud password protects the account even if someone intercepts the login code from SMS. It is the single most important Telegram setting.
A cloud password is set: even with the code from an SMS, nobody can sign in to your account without it.
The device checks run here on your phone. Only the cloud password status is asked of Telegram, the same way Settings does; nothing is sent anywhere else.
